comparison.objective: Insert a long board behind two boards already leaning in a rack without removing them.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand maintains a temporary gap while the other inserts a long rigid object, then restores the supported stack.
comparison.success_condition: All boards remain on the rack floor; the long board is at the back and the short boards lean onto it after release.
comparison.reason: This tests bimanual gap maintenance and constrained placement, not maintenance-tool control or dynamic commissioning.
